Connect Stripe: your account id, and for live mode, test mode or both the API key and the signing
secret of the webhook endpoint that points at Voidhash. Test mode alone suits a staging setup; its
purchases never unlock production.

Without the webhook secrets it saves the rest and prints the address to point them at. In a terminal
the keys are typed without echo, which keeps them out of your shell history; they are never printed.

Usage:
  voidhash provider connect stripe [flags]

Flags:
      --account-id <id>               Your Stripe account id, acct_...
  -h, --help                          Show help for this command
      --json                          Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --live-secret-key <key>         A live secret or restricted key, sk_live_... or rk_live_...;
                                      leave out to connect test mode only
      --live-webhook-secret <secret>  The signing secret of the live webhook endpoint pointing at
                                      Voidhash, whsec_...
      --project <project>             Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                      (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                         Print only ids, one per line
      --test-secret-key <key>         A test secret or restricted key, sk_test_... or rk_test_...;
                                      leave out to connect live mode only
      --test-webhook-secret <secret>  The signing secret of the test webhook endpoint pointing at
                                      Voidhash, whsec_...

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider connect stripe
  voidhash provider connect stripe --account-id acct_123 --test-secret-key sk_test_... --test-webhook-secret whsec_...
